value: Must have completed Class 9 advance registration and cleared Sent-up screening test.
Must have pursued a regular course of study in Class 9 and 10 in a CBSE affiliated school.
Must have passed Class 9 from PSEB or equivalent recognized board with Punjabi compulsory.
Graduation Degree for Level 5 & 6 posts; 12th (+2 Stage) pass for Level 2 & 3 posts.
Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University or equivalent institute.
10+2 (Intermediate) pass from UP Board or recognized equivalent State/Central Board.
Graduate Degree in any stream from a Central/State recognized University or institution.
